pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/94434

Monitoring data of our stack can now be stored in `metrics-{component}*` patterns when collected through elastic-agent. [Our documentation](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/kibana/current/monitoring-data.html) recommends to use the monitoring_user role to view the data in Stack Monitoring application but that role does not have permissions to read from the metrics pattern.

Added read and read_cross_cluster privileges to the relevant metrics indices
pr_comments: @elastic/es-data-management would love a double check from the team to verify we're not missing anything to allow read access to `metrics-..` pattern

issue_context.title: [monitoring] update monitoring_user role
issue_context.body:
Monitoring data can now be stored in `metrics-*` patterns when collected through elastic-agent. [Our documentation](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/kibana/current/monitoring-data.html) recommends to use the `monitoring_user` role to view the data in Stack Monitoring application but that role does not have permissions to read from the metrics pattern.

`monitoring_user` should be allowed the same permissions on `metrics-*` as `.monitoring-*`
comments: metrics data being delivered to separate data streams we should take the opportunity to go with the least privilege here and only allow reading from stack components: `metrics-elasticsearch.*,metrics-kibana.*,metrics-beats.*,metrics-enterprisesearch.*,metrics-logstash.*`

review_comments: All the tests include something matching the `.*`, but to prevent it from being changed to `.+` in the future, can you add an assert for `metricsPrefix + "elasticsearch"` (or some other equivalent example)?
